title: Green Lasagne
subtitle: with silverbeet, cream and St Maure cheese
description: A rich cheesy lasagne layered with bechamel, silverbeet or kale cooked in cream, mozzarella and rounds of St Maure goat's cheese, finished with parmesan.

steps.text: Make the bechamel: melt the butter in a pan, add the flour all at once and cook over low heat, stirring, for a few seconds until it comes together. Add the milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg and cook for 4-5 minutes until thickened. Cool to room temperature.
Make the greens: heat the olive oil in a pot and cook the chopped onions, stirring, for 5-10 minutes until translucent. Add the chopped silverbeet or kale, stir and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Add the cream and 1/2 teaspoon salt, stir, bring to the boil, lower the heat and cook for about 10 minutes until the liquid reduces. Cool to room temperature.

Assemble: arrange a layer of lasagne sheets on the base of a baking dish, spread a quarter of the bechamel over it, pour a third of the greens on top and scatter with mozzarella. Repeat twice more. Top with rounds of St Maure, another layer of lasagne sheets and the remaining bechamel.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for about 45 minutes. Raise the oven to maximum, remove the foil, sprinkle with parmesan and bake for 5-8 more minutes until nicely browned.
